scope: numerical self-checks and frozen evaluation protocol only; no research-candidate comparison executed

operator.higher_order_boundary_assumption: powers of the Dirichlet Laplacian; u=0 alone is insufficient to define a general fourth/sixth-order PDE

initialization.boundary_handling: known homogeneous boundary values enforced; noisy endpoint observations retained in future scoring
initialization.fit_information: initial observations and spatial grid only; no PDE truth, selected model, future observations, or noise-level tuning
initialization.forecast_role: separate frozen initialization ablation, never a per-method optimization

spectrum.interpretation: bounded-frequency/zero-order growth is not by itself ill-posedness; unbounded positive high-frequency rates are a distinct continuum issue

unstable_numerical_fixture.metric_domain: all future time rows and all observed spatial nodes; t0 excluded
unstable_numerical_fixture.metric_method: signed log-domain modal propagation and orthonormal Parseval identity, including boundary observation errors
unstable_numerical_fixture.underflow_policy: all modal logs retained in score; only optional real-valued materialization may round negligible decayed amplitudes to zero
unstable_numerical_fixture.whole_library_comparison_policy: report supported/unsupported coverage separately; do not exclude unsupported candidates to select a preferred model
unstable_numerical_fixture.continuum_claim: This is the full finite observed-grid spectral realization, not proof that an unstable continuum PDE is well posed.

finite_band_fixture.interpretation: bounded-frequency/zero-order growth is not by itself ill-posedness; unbounded positive high-frequency rates are a distinct continuum issue

frozen_initial_reconstruction.boundary_handling: known homogeneous boundary values enforced; noisy endpoint observations retained in future scoring
frozen_initial_reconstruction.fit_information: initial observations and spatial grid only; no PDE truth, selected model, future observations, or noise-level tuning
frozen_initial_reconstruction.forecast_role: separate frozen initialization ablation, never a per-method optimization

gate_policy: research comparisons require root confirmation that numerical tail gate is resolved and common holdout/protocol are frozen
limits: Odd derivatives, variable coefficients, nonlinear terms, and unprovided boundary realizations are unsupported, not failed algorithms.
Reporting only supported candidates is a coverage analysis; it must not silently change selection over the complete library.
High-order sine propagation assumes powers of the Dirichlet Laplacian, not merely u=0 as the only boundary condition.
Frozen IC smoothing attenuates every mode continuously; it does not remove noise bias or make an ill-posed continuum operator well posed.
No model-specific or truth-tuned initial reconstruction is allowed; raw and frozen reconstruction are separate identical-input ablations.
Full observed-grid dynamics still represent a finite spectral discretization; continuum high-frequency behavior is reported separately.
The score compares future noisy observations, excludes initialization rows, and includes boundary measurement discrepancies.
